header.title: Claim Status Codes (277)
header.method: WebFetch of the public page; index read in two offsets; 16 rows re-fetched and compared (15 matched, 1 partially readable)

coverage.note: The fetch tool reads at most ~115-140k characters of page text; rows after 555 were not reachable in this session. Codes beyond that point are absent, not deleted. Gaps in numbering (e.g. 36, 43, 58) are as listed on the page.

license.policy: Only code identifiers, published dates, and short description excerpts needed for routing are stored. Full descriptions and usage notes require a licensed X12 code-list import before production use (build pack doc 04).
